{{Color box|purple|border=silver}} [[Padayon Pilipino|PADAYN]] |blank2_name = Congressional bloc |blank2_info = Majority }} '''Misamis Oriental's 2nd congressional district''' is one of the two [[congressional districts of the Philippines]] in the province of [[Misamis Oriental]]. It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|House of Representatives]] since 1987.{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 21, 2021}} The district encompasses the western half of the province consisting of the city of [[El Salvador, Misamis Oriental|El Salvador]] and the municipalities of [[Alubijid]], [[Claveria, Misamis Oriental|Claveria]], [[Gitagum]], [[Initao]], [[Jasaan]], [[Laguindingan]], [[Libertad, Misamis Oriental|Libertad]], [[Lugait]], [[Manticao]], [[Naawan]], [[Opol]], [[Tagoloan, Misamis Oriental|Tagoloan]] and [[Villanueva, Misamis Oriental|Villanueva]].{{cite web|url=https://www.chanrobles.com/ordinance.htm |title=The 1987 Constitution of the Republic of the Philippines |publisher=Chan Robles Virtual Law Library |accessdate=February 21, 2021}} It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Yevgeny Emano|Yevgeny Vincente B. Emano]] of the [[Nacionalista Party]] and [[Padayon Pilipino]].{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 21, 2021}} ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Congress ! rowspan="2" | Party ! rowspan="2" | Electoral history ! rowspan="2" | Constituent
